exhausted_reason: The revealed validation cohort has been reused for sequential adaptive estimator and nuisance-model screening. Further promotion decisions on this same cohort would create validation-shopping risk even without opening the final holdout.
comparison_rule: Development attempts must be interpreted against a baseline recomputed inside the same run. Small cross-run floating-point differences on hosted hardware must not be treated as method improvements.

attempts.summary: RecSys-style beta-IPS + SNIPS + DR BLUE reduced Meta SE but worsened Meta validation absolute error from about 0.002108 to about 0.002460; SWITCH-DR threshold 5 remained the validation winner.
Cross-fitted additive normalization control on DR reduced SE by only about 0.014% while worsening DR point error.
The one-Q empirical-likelihood specialization converged cleanly but materially underperformed the same-run SWITCH-DR threshold-5 winner.
SNDR was worse than both the same-run SWITCH-DR threshold-5 winner and ordinary DR. PR 48 only repaired negative-result artifact preservation for the same method/cohort.
Author-code RandomForest Q reduced the selected estimator SE by about 2.61% but worsened validation point error.
MRDR-trained logistic Q changed the validation winner to DR-OS lambda 1 but materially worsened validation point error.
